title: 12-name watchlist · 07 Nov 2026 (Sat) · 16:00 SGT
summary: One previously omitted Microsoft report is added as a clearly labelled late-observed coverage correction. No distinct new company development was verified in the checked 03:30–08:00 UTC window. All 12 November 6 regular-session closes and all 72 adjusted-close baselines were freshly rechecked and remain unchanged. Earlier research remains in retained dated reports.
coverage_note: Fixed cutoff: 7 November 16:00 SGT (08:00 UTC). Incremental window: 7 November 11:30–16:00 SGT, with a 30-minute overlap from the previous 12:00 SGT edition. Reuters searches, ten directly retrieved issuer listings and eleven accessible SEC feeds were checked; Micron and Alphabet issuer coverage was search-only. The Microsoft item predates this window and was absent from the 23 earlier durable editions checked. Coverage is partial, and search silence does not establish that no news occurred. All prior editions, reports and calls remain unchanged.
price_basis: USD regular-session closes for 6 Nov 2026, the latest completed US session at cutoff. Fresh Yahoo Finance daily series and regularMarketTime metadata retrieved 7 Nov 08:05:27–08:06:13 UTC verify all 12 closes. Exact vendor quote timestamps remain 6 Nov 21:00:00–21:00:02 UTC for eleven names and 21:03:23 UTC for BRK.B; each quoted price matches the completed daily bar. Daily changes compare Nov 6 with Nov 5 ordinary closes. Adjusted closes are separate cumulative-return endpoints. Daily-bar timestamps are session labels, not substituted quote timestamps. Postmarket observations are excluded. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR. These saved observations are not live.
return_basis: Six cumulative 1–6 month returns use Yahoo adjusted closes reflecting vendor split and dividend/distribution adjustments. Formula: (endpoint adjusted close / baseline adjusted close - 1) x 100. Source values are rounded to cents before independent Decimal arithmetic; percentages round to two decimals. Baselines are the latest available sessions on or before each monthly anniversary: 6 Oct, 4 Sep, 6 Aug, 6 Jul, 5 Jun and 6 May 2026. Returns are not annualised and exclude investor fees, tax and FX. No independent reconstruction of dividend-adjustment factors or reinvestment model is claimed.
caveats: Reuters coverage is search-based and partial, not an exhaustive wire feed. The Microsoft article’s qualified text and original timestamp were returned through search; direct page access was unavailable.

Amazon SEC and Micron IR prior HTTP 403 responses were respected without direct retry. Alphabet IR direct access remains unavailable. Ten other issuer listings and eleven SEC feeds were directly checked.

Issuer listing dates are not treated as exact publication timestamps. Date-only posts were not arbitrarily placed inside the cutoff window. Previously covered events are excluded unless a substantive update is verified.

The one late-observed item is labelled as earlier evidence, not new in-window news. Eleven companies have no new narrative in this edition; empty research arrays do not erase earlier research or imply a new bullish or bearish view.

Price and baseline checks use one vendor, Yahoo Finance, without independent cross-vendor corroboration. Vendor split/dividend adjustments are not independently reconstructed. Cents-first arithmetic is reproducible from displayed inputs and can differ slightly from unrounded calculations.

rows.name: Microsoft

research.headline: Coverage correction: Microsoft reportedly winds down Oracle AI-capacity rental
facts: Late-observed evidence, published by Reuters November 6 at 17:46:46 UTC: Bloomberg, citing unnamed sources, reported Microsoft was winding down Oracle capacity after nonrenewal. The process reportedly began in prior months.
Oracle told Reuters that demand remained strong, including older GPUs. Microsoft had not responded; current issuer confirmation was not verified.

Oracle’s original November 8, 2023 announcement confirms a multiyear arrangement supplying OCI infrastructure alongside Azure for Bing inference. This historical release does not confirm the reported wind-down.
research.analysis: If confirmed, this could reflect procurement discipline, without proving weaker aggregate AI demand.
research.risks: Economics, replacement capacity and migration costs remain uncertain.
research.next_watch: Watch for issuer confirmation and financial effects.
